label: Scientific calculator
empty: Create a calculation and link it to the work it supports.
name: Name
copyFailed: Could not copy the result. Select the result text to copy it.
emptyResult: Enter a value or choose a function.
timeout: Calculation exceeded the time limit. Simplify the expression.
engineError: The calculation engine could not load.
incomplete: Complete the function or bracket before calculating.
limit: Use up to 100 expressions, 2,000 characters each and 20,000 characters per worksheet.
precisionInfo: Decimal arithmetic uses 64 significant digits. Results show up to 32 significant digits. Reusing a calculation keeps its expression and computes it again. Integer base conversion is exact.
valuesHint: Separate numbers with spaces, commas or new lines.
legacyEngine: This saved revision uses the original decimal calculation engine.
approximateInfo: Approximate result: 64 significant digits during calculation, up to 32 displayed.
exactPrecisionInfo: Integer and rational arithmetic is exact, including dependent spreadsheet formulas. Recurring fractions remain ratios. Unit conversions and non-rational functions use 64-digit decimal arithmetic and are marked approximate; up to 32 digits are displayed. Calculations that exceed the resource budget stop without rounding an exact value.
fixedPolicyEngine: This saved revision uses the fixed exact/64-digit engine.
policyMeaning: Exact rational results are not rounded. These limits stop exhausted calculations; they never replace an exact result with an approximation. The explicit round() function retains its own rounding rule.
policyEngine: Engine 3, mathjs {version}. Working digits: 16-256; displayed digits: 1 to working digits. Exact bits: 64-65,536; arithmetic operations: 1-50,000; time: 1-5,000 ms per evaluation request.
invalidPolicy: Enter values within the declared limits; displayed digits cannot exceed working digits.
policyApproximation: Approximate result: {working} working digits, up to {display} displayed; {rounding}.
policyLegacyError: This historical engine cannot use configurable precision. Choose Use configurable precision to create a new revision.
policyLibraryError: The library version retained by this calculation is unavailable. Its saved expression and policy remain unchanged.
policyRealError: No finite real scalar result is available. Complex-valued operations are not supported.
